I am an old woman with no schooling, and this small plot of beans is intercropped to help feed my family. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer for beans when my maize plot needs it more, and beans can fix their own nitrogen anyway. I will spread manure from our goats and cows to give the soil strength, and I will plant the bean seeds I kept from last year's harvest. We will do all the work ourselves with hoes, as we have always done, without spraying any chemicals because they are too expensive and not needed for beans in our rain-fed fields.
